actions.action: Inspect leaf undersides with flashlight or magnifying glass for stippling/webbing
Tap a leaf over white paper to look for moving specks
Check soil moisture 2-3 inches down with finger
If dry, water thoroughly until it drains
If soggy, let soil dry out before watering again
Make sure the pot drains well
Flush the pot to remove salt/fertilizer buildup
Trim brown tips with clean scissors
Group plants together to raise humidity
Move plant out of harsh direct sun
If mites confirmed, spray in shade avoiding hot afternoons
Post a close-up photo of leaf undersides

reason: The answer mentions spider mites only as something to rule out while favoring care issues, offers no effective mite treatment like a systemic, and its advice to hold off spraying likely delays the needed fix.
